title: A wonderful experience...
text:
A wonderful experience from start to finish!
Our lovely guides Alex and Nicky were funny,  engaging and knowledgeable about the area and cava/wine making. The visit to the cava vinyard and the owner Montse's tour were brilliant,  and the cava delicious. Making (and eating!) paella was high on my list of things to do,  and it did not disappoint!
author: annette_s

title: An absolute must!
text: This is an absolute MUST while in Sitges/Barcelona. The entire staff was so incredible, friendly, funny, hospitable and 100% lovely!  The bike ride is pretty flat, slight and short incline/declines but nothing major. Learning about the wine and cava was fantastic!  And the cooking part was a wonderful end to a fun adventure.  Thank you to our amazing hosts for a wonderful day!
author: Tamara_M

title: Great experience
text: Great experience. Lovely vineyard and winery. Would definitely recommend!
author: G9044GSdeborahp

title: Cava and paella? Yes please!!!
text: What a fabulous experience! A leisurely gravel bike ride through some wine country, followed by some very nice Cava, a very interesting tour of the winery lead by the owner! Afterwards, a paella cooking class out by the pool with hands-on experience and more Cava!! It was a great day!
author: Reed S

title: Top Notch--winery and food
text: This experience was awesome from start to finish!!  Alex was a great guide!!  The bike ride around the winery, the winery tour and the cooking of the paella at the end was the best.
author: Vicki_D

title: Experience not to be missed!
text:
We had a wonderful half day with Alex at the Romagosa Torne vineyard, he picked us up from our hotel in Sitges at 9am and drove to the vineyard, we had a bike tour experience around the grounds, Alex was very knowledgeable about the history of the vines and local information, he wanted us to get involved tasting the grapes and almonds on route, the bike ride could have been slightly longer but the weather sadly cut this short.

author: JadeRebeccaC

title: A great experience!
text: This was such a fun way to spend the morning. The bike ride was a pleasant and relatively easy. The cava was amazing and so was the tour. Well worth it!
author: trinityg959

title: Fantastic time cycling, sampling cava and making new friends in Sitges
text: Alex was a fantastic guide.  I can highly recommend this activity.  We got picked up from the hotel, met some great fellow travellers, cycled through a vineyard (nice pace, very inclusive), sampled cava, learnt about cava making then made and ate paella for lunch.  For the price - very good value.  We would do it again! such a great way to spend half a day and Alex was great fun and very knowledgeable!
author: Z5232IJsuem

title: Seriously, a great tour!!
text: Alex went above and beyond for our tour! His constant communication assured me we were with the right guide! Always answered me quickly and respectfully. The tour was very informative and we saw such beautiful country on the bike ride (mostly down hill until the very end 😉). The Cava winery was a tremendous tribute to generations of making great wine; you could feel the love and history with each sip!
author: Amy_N

title: Authentic and diverse tour!
text: Great fun and learned a lot about cava in the region at a local cava producer and cooked a great paella. Plus a bike ride through the vineyards near by. Diverse type of tour! Alex was a great tour guide too!
author: AnaMaia1
